g.text: Title: Bit-line DAC connections, clamps and service selection

g.desc: Title: Bit-line DAC connections, clamps and service selection

g.text: U1516-U1519 each select one bit line from their eight-channel group.

g.desc: U1516-U1519 each select one bit line from their eight-channel group.

g.text: MAT_BL_A0, MAT_BL_A1 and MAT_BL_A2 are shared address inputs. The selector

g.desc: MAT_BL_A0, MAT_BL_A1 and MAT_BL_A2 are shared address inputs. The selector

g.text: outputs are MAT_BL_BANK_0-3; the upper address selection on the service-router

g.desc: outputs are MAT_BL_BANK_0-3; the upper address selection on the service-router

g.text: sheet chooses which bank reaches MAT_BL_SERVICE.

g.desc: sheet chooses which bank reaches MAT_BL_SERVICE.

g.text: MAT_SERVICE_SAFE enables the local service selectors. The service connection is

g.desc: MAT_SERVICE_SAFE enables the local service selectors. The service connection is

g.text: separate from the VMM DAC switches, so firmware must prepare the bit-line

g.desc: separate from the VMM DAC switches, so firmware must prepare the bit-line

g.text: masks before making a read, set, reset or forming connection. The chosen line

g.desc: masks before making a read, set, reset or forming connection. The chosen line

g.text: must not be clamped against the active source.

g.desc: must not be clamped against the active source.

g.text: The switch packages use P15 and N15 with local supply bypassing.

g.desc: The switch packages use P15 and N15 with local supply bypassing.

g.text: BL6 and BL7 now use their dedicated BL_DAC6 and BL_DAC7 sources.

g.desc: BL6 and BL7 now use their dedicated BL_DAC6 and BL_DAC7 sources.

g.text: All other DAC, clamp and service-selector connections are unchanged.

g.desc: All other DAC, clamp and service-selector connections are unchanged.

g.text: This sheet contains BL0-BL31 in four groups of eight. Each terminal has two

g.desc: This sheet contains BL0-BL31 in four groups of eight. Each terminal has two

g.text: ADG5412 switch paths: one towards a buffered DAC source and one towards GND.

g.desc: ADG5412 switch paths: one towards a buffered DAC source and one towards GND.

g.text: The MAT_BL_VMM mask controls the DAC paths, while MAT_BL_ZERO controls the

g.desc: The MAT_BL_VMM mask controls the DAC paths, while MAT_BL_ZERO controls the

g.text: clamps. These two masks are generated by the serial image registers.

g.desc: clamps. These two masks are generated by the serial image registers.

g.text: Bit-line DAC connections, clamps and service selection

g.desc: Bit-line DAC connections, clamps and service selection

g.text: For drive, enable the DAC path and release its ground clamp; for GND, do the

g.desc: For drive, enable the DAC path and release its ground clamp; for GND, do the

g.text: opposite. All 32 optional 1M BL bleeders are DNP to avoid unmeasured WRITE

g.desc: opposite. All 32 optional 1M BL bleeders are DNP to avoid unmeasured WRITE

g.text: return current. With both switches OFF, a BL may float. Use BL_ZERO for a

g.desc: return current. With both switches OFF, a BL may float. Use BL_ZERO for a

g.text: defined level or deliberate discharge. The 10k resistors bias control pins only.

g.desc: defined level or deliberate discharge. The 10k resistors bias control pins only.
